Test Steps: Verify Admin can create a new Job Posting
Test Data: 1. Go to Recruitment > Job Postings 2. Click 'Add New Job' 3. Enter Title, JD, Salary, Experience 4. Save
Date of execution: Job should be created successfully and status marked as 'Active'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory Job Details are missing
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add New Job' 2. Leave 'Job Title' and 'Description' blank 3. Save
Date of execution: System should display validation error indicating missing mandatory fields.

Test Steps: Verify Active jobs are visible on the public Careers Page
Test Data: 1. Create an 'Active' Job 2. Navigate to public Careers portal (e.g. /careers)
Date of execution: The newly created job should appear on the public board for applicants.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can close/deactivate a Job Posting
Test Data: 1. Find an Active Job 2. Change Status to 'Closed'
Date of execution: Status updates to 'Closed', and it should no longer accept new applications.

Test Steps: Verify Closed jobs are immediately removed from Careers Page
Test Data: 1. Close a Job 2. Refresh public Careers portal
Date of execution: The closed job should instantly disappear from the public facing board.

Test Steps: Verify Candidate can successfully apply for an open position
Test Data: 1. Go to Careers Page 2. Select Job 3. Fill Form (Name, Email, Phone) 4. Upload Resume 5. Submit
Date of execution: Application submits successfully, candidate sees success message.

Test Steps: Verify Candidate receives automated confirmation email after applying
Test Data: 1. Apply for job 2. Check Candidate's inbox
Date of execution: Candidate receives email: 'We have received your application'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Candidate applies with invalid email format
Test Data: 1. Apply for job 2. Enter email 'candidate@.com' 3. Submit
Date of execution: System blocks submission and displays 'Invalid Email format' error.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Candidate attempts duplicate application
Test Data: 1. Apply for a Job using email A 2. Attempt to apply for the SAME job using email A again
Date of execution: System blocks submission: 'You have already applied for this position'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Candidate uploads unsupported Resume format
Test Data: 1. Apply for job 2. Upload an executable file (.exe) 3. Submit
Date of execution: System rejects upload and prompts 'Only PDF/Word documents are allowed'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Resume file exceeds max size limit
Test Data: 1. Apply for job 2. Upload a 20MB PDF 3. Submit
Date of execution: System rejects upload and prompts 'File size exceeds maximum limit (e.g. 5MB)'.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can view list of applied candidates for a specific Job
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Open Job 'Software Engineer' 3. Click 'View Applicants'
Date of execution: Table should list all candidates who applied for this specific job.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can download Candidate Resume
Test Data: 1. Go to Applicant list 2. Click 'Download Resume' icon
Date of execution: Resume file downloads correctly, is not corrupted, and matches original upload.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can change applicant status in the pipeline
Test Data: 1. Select Candidate A 2. Change status from 'Applied' to 'Shortlisted'
Date of execution: System updates Candidate status and moves them to Shortlisted column/view.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can schedule an Interview for a Shortlisted candidate
Test Data: 1. Select Shortlisted Candidate 2. Click 'Schedule Interview' 3. Pick Date, Time, Interviewer
Date of execution: Interview is scheduled and appears on the Interviewer's dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify validation when scheduling an interview in the past
Test Data: 1. Select Candidate 2. Click 'Schedule Interview' 3. Pick a past date
Date of execution: System restricts selecting past dates in the calendar picker.

Test Steps: Verify Interviewer & Candidate receive email invites upon scheduling
Test Data: 1. Schedule Interview 2. Check Candidate and Interviewer inbox
Date of execution: Both parties receive email containing Date, Time, and Interview Link/Location.

Test Steps: Verify Interviewer can reschedule an interview
Test Data: 1. Interviewer opens scheduled interview 2. Changes Date/Time 3. Saves
Date of execution: Interview is rescheduled, and notification emails are sent automatically.

Test Steps: Verify Interviewer can submit feedback and rating
Test Data: 1. Interviewer logs in 2. Opens Candidate Profile 3. Fills feedback form & Rating out of 5
Date of execution: Feedback is saved and visible to Admin on the candidate profile.

Test Steps: Verify non-assigned employees cannot submit feedback for a candidate
Test Data: 1. Employee B logs in 2. Attempts to submit feedback for Employee A's interview
Date of execution: System blocks access or hides the feedback form for unauthorized employees.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can generate an Offer Letter from template
Test Data: 1. Change status to 'Selected' 2. Click 'Generate Offer' 3. Fill Salary details
Date of execution: System merges candidate details with template and generates PDF Offer Letter.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can email Offer Letter directly from HRMS
Test Data: 1. Generate Offer 2. Click 'Send to Candidate'
Date of execution: Candidate receives email with the Offer Letter attached as PDF.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can convert 'Hired' candidate into 'Employee'
Test Data: 1. Candidate accepts offer 2. Admin clicks 'Convert to Employee' 3. Reviews mapped data
Date of execution: System copies Candidate details (Name, Email, Resume) to Employee master database.

Test Steps: Verify validation when converting a 'Rejected' candidate to Employee
Test Data: 1. Change Candidate status to 'Rejected' 2. Attempt to click 'Convert to Employee'
Date of execution: System should hide or disable the 'Convert to Employee' button.

Test Steps: Verify duplicate Employee prevention during conversion
Test Data: 1. Convert Candidate to Employee 2. Attempt to click 'Convert' again on same Candidate
Date of execution: System should show error 'Candidate has already been onboarded as an Employee'.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can move rejected candidates to Talent Pool
Test Data: 1. Change status to 'Rejected' 2. Mark as 'Add to Talent Pool'
Date of execution: Candidate profile remains searchable in the database for future reference.

Test Steps: Verify search functionality inside Talent Pool
Test Data: 1. Go to Talent Pool 2. Search by Skill 'Java'
Date of execution: System filters and returns previously archived candidates matching the skill.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Job Search on Careers Page
Test Data: 1. Go to public careers page 2. Enter SQL payload in Job search bar
Date of execution: System sanitizes query and safely returns 'No jobs found'.

Test Steps: Verify XSS payload in Candidate Name during Application
Test Data: 1. Apply for Job 2. Enter <script>alert('XSS')</script> in Name
Date of execution: System sanitizes input so payload doesn't execute when Admin views the profile.

Test Steps: Verify unauthenticated users cannot view applicant data
Test Data: 1. Hit Applicant API endpoint or URL without logging in
Date of execution: System returns '401 Unauthorized' and redirects to login page.
